title: The exact projective Wick recentering is not uniformly semibounded and fails Mosco liminf

projective_instability.recentered_family: Subtracting the exact scalar cocycle gives K_N^proj=H_N-6gC_N^2=H0+gV_N, whose interaction is the exact conditional-expectation martingale
projective_instability.bottom_divergence: K1479 gives inf spec(K_N^proj)=E_N-6gC_N^2<=-c_g N^(5/2), so this projectively compatible family has no cutoff-uniform lower bound
projective_instability.weak_fourth_chaos_escape: Let chi_N=V_N/sigma_N. For every fixed cutoff M, conditional expectation gives P_(F_M)chi_N=V_M/sigma_N, whose norm tends to zero because sigma_N=Theta(N^(5/2)); density of cylinder functions implies chi_N converges weakly to zero
projective_instability.weak_trial_limit: The normalized K1479 trial u_N=(1-a chi_N)/sqrt(1+a^2) converges weakly to the nonzero vacuum vector 1/sqrt(1+a^2)
projective_instability.mosco_liminf_failure: The projectively recentered quadratic values on u_N tend to minus infinity while u_N has a nonzero weak limit, contradicting the Mosco weak-liminf inequality for every finite semibounded limiting form on the fixed Gaussian Hilbert space
projective_instability.semibounded_consequence: The exact martingale recentering cannot supply the uniformly semibounded nontrivial limit left open by K1475; any such scalar recentering must differ from 6gC_N^2 by a divergent amount consistent with the true E_N
projective_instability.ceiling: This excludes the exact projective scalar recentering as a semibounded Mosco route on the fixed Gaussian representation. It does not exclude arbitrary strong-resolvent limits unbounded below, E_N+O(1) recentering, singular dressing, non-Gaussian measures or changed representations
